accommodation.name: EMA accommodation
accommodation.text: There are no application fees. Tuition fees can be paid in two instalments. The school does not provide accommodation services, but offers practical advice to support students in their search. For full tuition details, please refer to the programme page on our website.

campuses.title: Paris
campuses.text: Delivered in English on our Paris campus, the Bachelor Applied Management and Economics is a three-year programme that prepares students for management roles in an international environment.

campuses.title: Paris
campuses.text: In Year 1, you build a strong foundation in business and management, alongside applied mathematics, statistics and accounting. You also strengthen your French language proficiency, while building essential academic, digital and teamwork skills. You also explore key global challenges, including ethical and sustainability issues. Weekly career workshops support your professional development and a compulsory placement provides early workplace experience.

campuses.title: Paris
campuses.text: The Bachelor in Applied Management and Economics is a 3-year full-time programme, delivered in both English and French on our Paris campus.
